Package org.apache.hadoop.fs.permission

Class FsCreateModes

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.fs.permission.FsPermission
org.apache.hadoop.fs.permission.FsCreateModes
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectInputValidation, Serializable, Writable
@Public @Evolving public final class FsCreateModes extends FsPermission
A class that stores both masked and unmasked create modes and is a drop-in replacement for masked permission.
